text:
Predicates:
PublishingHouse(x) ::: x is a publishing house.
Specializes(x, y) ::: x specializes in y.
Translates(x, y, z) ::: x translates y into z.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
English(x) ::: x is in English.
From(x, y) ::: x is from y.
Premises:
PublishingHouse(newVesselPress) ::: New Vessel Press is a publishing house.
Specializes(newVesselPress, ∀x (Book(x) → Translates(newVesselPress, x, english))) ::: New Vessel Press specializes in translating foreign literature into English.
∀x (Book(x) ∧ Translates(newVesselPress, x, english) → English(x)) ::: All of New Vessel Press's published books are in English.
Book(neapolitanChronicles) ∧ Translates(newVesselPress, neapolitanChronicles, english) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles is a book published by New Vessel Press.
From(neapolitanChronicles, italian) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles was translated from Italian.
Book(palaceOfFlies) ∧ Translates(newVesselPress, palaceOfFlies, english) ::: Palace of Flies is a book published by New Vessel Press.
Conclusion:
English(neapolitanChronicles) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles is an English book.
